linux.runtime_note: Briefcase Linux system packages use the distribution's system Python runtime. The user does not install Python manually; apt resolves package dependencies. This is installer-simple but not a byte-self-contained runtime in the Windows/macOS sense.
linux.production_blocker: Signed Linux distribution/repository path and broader distribution compatibility validation

production_readiness.reason: The packaging and install/launch lifecycle are proven, but Windows public-trust signing and macOS Developer ID notarization are not yet provisioned.
remaining_external_prerequisites: Obtain an accepted Windows code-signing route (preferred OSS route: SignPath Foundation if accepted; otherwise OV certificate).
Enroll in Apple Developer Program and provision Developer ID Application/notarization credentials.
remaining_product_acceptance: Validate signed Windows installer on a clean non-developer machine with a real user.
Validate Developer-ID-signed and notarized macOS DMG on a separate Mac.
Run a real literature search, acquire at least one OA full text, and verify its integrity from each target installer build.
Decide whether Ubuntu/Debian native package coverage is sufficient for Linux beta or whether Flatpak/AppImage is required.
